review_history.note: The only review states are automated Codex and owner comments; GitHub still requires an approval for the merged PR.

finding: PR #212 merged despite an unsatisfied one-approval gate. The API does not expose whether an administrative bypass or a transient protection change was used; either way the documented independent-review gate was not effective. Protections remain enabled and were not weakened.

same_pattern.note: Both merged with only COMMENTED reviews.

remediation: The closure PR requires a fresh APPROVED review on its exact final head by someone other than the author.
An administrative override must be declared before the merge with its reason and compensating review plan; a post-hoc note is not approval.
If no independent reviewer is available, the PR remains unmerged and is reported as awaiting review.
